note: Seder Plate, Seder Steps and The Four Questions. The plate items and what three of them stand for come from the app's article Pesach and the Seder; the shank bone's and the egg's meanings and the layout (the Ari's arrangement, common in many homes) are not in the app yet and carry review notes. The fifteen steps are the traditional ones the article mentions; their names (except matzah, maror and Hallel) are not in the app data yet. The Four Questions follow the order most Ashkenazi haggadot print; Sephardi haggadot order them differently. Nothing here rules on practice.
